### 1. **FX/Crypto Regime Monitor with Agentic Alerts** `MEDIUM`

**Pitch:** Know when the market has structurally shifted before your risk manager flags it on a spreadsheet.

**Problem it solves:** FX and crypto desks adjust strategy based on volatility regimes — but most shops do this manually, with lag. No lightweight, ops-accessible tool detects regime changes in real time and explains *why* in plain English.

**Stack:** Python + `hmmlearn`/`ruptures` · `yfinance` + Binance WebSocket API · Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-6) · Streamlit · APScheduler · Twilio/SMTP alerts

**Build time:** 3–5 days to MVP

**Who cares:** Quant desks, risk managers, Afterprime internally (direct visa-case value)

**LinkedIn angle:** *"I spent 18 months flagging vol regime changes manually in FX ops. So I built a tool that does it in real time and writes the alert for me. Here's what it would have caught in the August 2026 carry unwind — 4 hours before the desk noticed."*

---

### 2. **Central Bank Synthesis Agent** `MEDIUM`

**Pitch:** Turn 200 pages of central bank communications into one actionable FX trade brief — before the sell-side morning note hits your inbox.

**Problem it solves:** Synthesising Fed/RBA/ECB/BOJ minutes into rate path views takes 2–3 hours of reading. With five major central banks on overlapping cycles (Fed paused, RBA hiking, ECB cutting), the burden has never been higher for a solo manager.

**Stack:** Python + `feedparser`/`requests` · FRED API (free) · `pdfplumber` · Claude API with multi-step agentic chain · LangGraph/asyncio · Streamlit or scheduled email delivery

**Build time:** 4–6 days to MVP

**Who cares:** Investment management firms, macro hedge funds, VC firms in fintech/AI-in-finance

**LinkedIn angle:** *"I'm a CFA L2 candidate who reads central bank minutes obsessively. I also hate reading central bank minutes. So I built an agent that reads them for me and produces the same FX bias analysis I'd write manually — in 60 seconds."*

---

### 3. **LP-Grade Portfolio Risk Report Generator** `HARD`

**Pitch:** The institutional reporting infrastructure that most emerging fund managers outsource for $5,000/month — rebuilt as a 200-line Python script and a Claude prompt.

**Problem it solves:** Producing monthly LP letters, risk attribution reports, drawdown analysis, and Sharpe/Sortino commentary at institutional quality requires either expensive consultants or 8+ hours per report. This tool takes a portfolio CSV and produces a PDF-quality investor report in under 3 minutes.

**Stack:** Python + `pandas`/`numpy`/`pyfolio` · `yfinance`/CCXT · Claude API for narrative commentary · `Plotly` for charts · `WeasyPrint`/`reportlab` for PDF assembly

**Build time:** 5–7 days to MVP

**Who cares:** Family offices, fund-of-funds, investment management recruiters, MDA operators

**LinkedIn angle:** *"I'm building toward running my own fund. The part I dreaded most was the reporting. So I built the infrastructure first. This tool produces a report that looks like it came from a $500M manager's IR team. Here's a redacted sample output."*
